title: SMOK RPM 2 Replacement coils 5 pack
description: The newest addition to SMOK’s bestselling RPM line-up, the SMOK RPM 2 is a powerful yet pocket friendly Coil bursting with features and versatility. These replaceable mesh coils for the SMOK RPM2 pods are precision-engineered for rich flavour and satisfying clouds. The RPM2 mesh coils are for direct to lung vaping and are for use with the RPM2 Pod.
